title: Step out and show them the touchline
titleKid: Go out and send them to the sideline
brief: Their centre-back is looking to go wide to their full-back.
briefKid: Their defender is looking to pass out wide.
question: Their full-back has it on the touchline. Where do you go?
questionKid: Their defender has the ball by the sideline. Where do you go?

takeaway.standard: When you are the nearest to a full-back on the touchline, step out and press from the inside so the only way on is down the line.
takeaway.kid: Nearest the ball by the sideline? Go to it from the middle side.

misconceptions.text: You came at them from the touchline side, which lets them cut inside toward the middle of the pitch.
misconceptions.textKid: Coming from the sideline lets them cut inside. Come from the middle side.

misconceptions.text: You held your spot in the middle, so their full-back has time to run or pick a pass, and nobody is closer than you.
misconceptions.textKid: Nobody else is close, so you need to go to the ball.
